project.name: jawelte (jndi-module aggregator)
project.description: The in-process JNDI naming tree, shared by every module that binds into it. jndi-module/api ships the JndiContextProvider port; jndi-module/impl ships the xbean-backed adapter that installs a naming provider once per JVM and hands out its single writable root. It exists as a module rather than as a core port because the core never looks anything up by name: naming is what individual integrations need (jta-module for the transaction artifacts today, and any later module that publishes something under a name), not what the test framework needs. Sharing one root is mandatory rather than tidy - installing a provider installs a fresh root, so a second module doing it independently would discard the first one's bindings.
